'''Dhal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] to the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], Dhal posed as [[Peyton Swole]], Director of Galactic Relations for [[the Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania]], to lure out the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] responsible for murdering the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kellian Jarro]] and the destruction of the [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']]. Luring the hunter to [[Quesh]], Dhal sprung a strike team to arrest the bounty hunter. The bounty hunter refused to cooperate and engaged the strike team. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] Dhal and his team tried to restrain the hunter, but were all [[Death/Legends|killed]].
